title: Academics - MPSTME
text:
MPSTME, a top engineering college in Mumbai was essentially established to serve the need of creating an innovative and integrated space for technology education interspersed with sound management practices that converged with changing industry as well as societal needs. The vision was to match the emerging demands in the field by creating holistically trained engineers possessing sound technical expertise as well as a vision to integrate their knowledge into creating technology that serves the changing needs of present world. MPSTME building today, with its new age engineering course in Mumbai, state-of-the-art labs and world class infrastructure stands a live testimony to the steady realization of this vision.
At MPSTME Engineering School, we offer a diverse range of departments that cater to the ever-evolving landscape of engineering and technology. Each department is dedicated to providing students with a comprehensive education, equipping them with the knowledge, skills, and practical experience needed to thrive in their chosen field.

Explore our engineering and technology programs at MPSTME and achieve your academic and professional goals. Our admissions team will guide you through the application process and help schedule campus visits and interviews. Join our dynamic learning environment and shape the future.
The academic year runs from July to April with a two month summer break in May and June. The year comprises of two semesters: July to November and November to April. Throughout the year students organize and participate in a range of events and competitions alongside academic learning. Assessment in each semester is continuous and includes mid-term tests and a term end exam.
In the year 2006, Mukesh Patel School of Technology Management and Engineering was officially inaugurated as the engineering and technology management school under NMIMS Deemed to be University. This school was conceived to serve the purposes of educational needs of the time vis-à-vis the society and the national economy. Learning and the application of the same was uppermost in the minds of the founders.
MPSTME offers skill development programmes designed to empower students with essential skills for personal and professional growth. These programs provide diverse opportunities for students to enhance their abilities, including leadership development, communication skills, and entrepreneurship. Through workshops, seminars, and hands-on projects, students can improve their teamwork, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills, preparing them to succeed in their academic and professional endeavors. Join us at MPSTME and become a future leader in engineering and technology.
To support ongoing research at the Mukesh Patel School of Technology Management and Engineering, Mumbai, NMIMS University, Petroleum Experts Limited (PETEX) has donated 10 free licenses of the complete MOVE Suite of Software, valued at £1,886,732 (INR 19,13,36553.53). The company, based at Edinburg, Scotland, has over 420 clients worldwide. They develop a wide range of software tools for petroleum engineering, structural geology and geo-mechanical modelling…

title: Placement Overview - MPSTME
text:
MPSTME is one of the most preferred campuses for job placements leading companies, with over 300 corporate partners that regularly conduct campus recruitment for Final Placements and Summer internships.
We focus on developing students into skilled professionals and responsible citizens, ensuring they are ready for the industry. MPSTME offers strong placement support in Management and Engineering, becoming a favored destination for hiring fresh talent due to its emphasis on quality, discipline, and ethics.
Our five-stage placement process includes pre-placement activities, career guidance, job opportunity counseling, executing placements, and post-placement reviews. We also promote continuous institute-industry interactions, alumni activities, participation in competitions, seminars, conferences, industry visits, and inviting industry speakers.
We appreciate and are grateful to the companies that have associated with us for their trust and successful engagement, resulting in productive placement seasons for our students.

title: ABOUT US - MPSTME
text:
Mukesh Patel School of Technology Management and Engineering, one of the top-ranking engineering colleges in Mumbai, accomplishes the vision it was birthed with – to create an innovative and integrated space for technology education combined with strong management practices. It bridges the gap between education and the real needs of both, industry and society.
Our mission drives us to meet the growing demands in the field by equipping students to be excellent engineers with strong technical skills and the ability to create technology that serves the modern world. With new-age engineering courses, state-of-the-art labs, and world-class infrastructure, the MPSTME building, today stands as a testament to our vision and mission.
Mukesh Patel School of Technology Management and Engineering, conceptualized by NMIMS Management as a Unique Technology and Management school, essentially integrates technical knowledge with innovative management practices ensuring the dissemination of knowledge that equips students to be game changers in terms of building sustainable and holistic society.
The idea was to ensure that education is not limited as an instrument for building knowledge, but further plays a pivotal role in creating a better and more humane society.
Mukesh Patel School of Technology Management and Engineering (MPSTME) is the brainchild of the NMIMS Management team. Established in 2006, it is affiliated to the Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies (NMIMS). NMIMS was founded in 1981 by Sri Vile Parle Kevlani Mandal as a management institute initially affiliated with the University of Mumbai. Over the years, NMIMS earned a reputation for its best practices in management education. In 2003, NMIMS became a deemed-to-be university, recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC).
At MPSTME, our leadership embodies the essence of our vision. Led by experienced and visionary individuals, our leadership team is dedicated to steering the institute toward excellence. Comprising accomplished professionals with a profound understanding of the education landscape, they are the driving force behind MPSTME’s journey. With a firm commitment to nurturing talent and fostering innovation, we ensure that MPSTME continues to remain at the forefront of technological advancements and management practices.
MPSTME management recognizes that a progressive institute is always differentiated by its sound administrative practices. Also, a well-connected administrative network that is well-aligned with the philosophy of the University is instrumental in taking the institute toward the realization of its vision. MPSTME’s administration comprises of stalwarts and leaders who are deeply in-tuned to MPSTME’s vision and aptly carry forward the NMIMS legacy. Administrative practices at MPSTME rest firmly on the principle of a flat hierarchical network and open-door policy. The Administrative support staff is trained and encouraged to ensure a smooth transition of students into the institute. Students are guided and supported at every step to ensure that their trajectory with us remains hassle-free and memorable in every aspect.
Accreditation is a process of quality assurance ensuring that a programme in an approved Institution is critically appraised for meeting the standards prescribed by the regulatory bodies. Accreditation ensures excellence in the learning experience for students, strengthens employers’ confidence in the degrees granted by the institution, and helps institutions to continually strive for improvement. In India, there are three national-level bodies namely the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC), and the National Board of Accreditation (NBA). All programs of MPSTME are approved by AICTE. Further, NMIMS deemed to be University is accredited by NAAC with a 3.59 CGPA and Grade A+ in the 3 rd cycle (Mumbai Campus). Additionally, Bachelor of Technology programs of IT and EXTC are accredited by NBA since 2014.

title: International Linkages - MPSTME
text:
The NMIMS Department of International Linkages (DIL) fosters partnerships with premier institutions around the world to enhance NMIMS’s standing as a world-class institution.
Towards the University’s Vision to be a globally admired University by 2030, DIL has actively engaged with leading institutions around the world to foster student and faculty exchange, research collaboration, and cross-cultural learning. Active international partnerships lead to exciting opportunities for faculty and students and provide the environment for high-quality research. Our work focuses on enhancing existing partnerships and seeking out new opportunities in line with NMIMS’s international strategy.
These collaborations explore various opportunities as below:
Dual Degree Programmes:
Students study a part of their Bachelor’s/ Master’s programme at NMIMS and then go and complete the programme at a partner University abroad. They have the opportunity to earn dual degrees from both NMIMS & International University.
Progression Agreements:
These agreements give NMIMS students a well-defined admission process when applying to a Master’s programme at our Partner Universities. Students may receive personalized information sessions, a streamlined admission process, a GMAT/GRE waiver linked to a good GPA, a Tuition fee waiver/scholarships, and an early admission offer which may enable them to apply in time for their VISA.
Short Term Mobility:
To provide cross-cultural exposure and a global perspective to the students, NMIMS University provides short-term mobility programmes with leading schools & organizations overseas. These may include Student Exchange, International Immersions, International Competitions, Research Internships, Industry Internships, Summer Schools, etc.
Visiting students adds to the diversity of Knowledge and Culture at the School, and enhances the effectiveness of its pedagogy.
Faculty Exchange Programmes:
Our highly qualified and expert faculty have the opportunity to travel abroad to our partner university for teaching assignments and for research. Similarly, International faculty visit the NMIMS campus. Faculty members benefit from exposure to a culturally varied and diverse faculty, with an opportunity to exchange ideas and observe a variety of styles. These programmes present a unique opportunity for interaction between foreign universities and Indian institutions.
Research Collaborations / Colloquiums / Seminars and Conferences:
Conferences and seminars are part of a research support system provided to faculty at NMIMS University and international scholars engaged in collaborative research or scholarly activity with NMIMS academics. The University organizes a number of research conferences and seminars with its International partners to disseminate research results, develop capacity, and promote interactions among the researchers. The University, supported by the colleges has organized numerous national and international conferences and seminars in various fields of study.

NMIMS continues to enable faculty from across the institution to work together to create actionable knowledge.
Our goal is to create research communities who share objectives that include technology, management, sciences and other humanities and social sciences. We strive to accomplish this by creating an infrastructure and support system to facilitate the world’s best research scholars in science, management and technology.
